## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

 However, automated text-reuse analysis via DharmaNexus identifies 132 matching passages across 53 other Pali texts, reflecting the highly formulaic structure of the Apadāna collection [DharmaNexus]. The strongest correspondences appear in both volumes of the commentary on the *Theragāthā* (*Theragāthā-aṭṭhakathā*), as well as related poems in the Therāpadāna featuring recurring poetic formulas of offerings and their karmic fruits, notably the *Ekapattadāyakattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 504), *Labujadāyakattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 384), and *Ucchaṅgapupphiyattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 419) [DharmaNexus]. In addition, DharmaNexus records a low-scoring automated alignment with a segment of the Chinese *Madhyama Āgama* (*Zhong ahan jing*, T 26, fascicle 37), though this represents an uncurated machine match rather than a confirmed historical parallel [DharmaNexus].
